visual_action: President Joe Biden speaks at a podium in what appears to be the chamber of the U.S. House of Representatives. An American flag with red and white stripes is visible behind him. Nancy Pelosi is seated behind him and to his right.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: He is the sole speaker in the video and the subject of the on-screen text.

cast.name: Nancy Pelosi
cast.evidence: She is visible seated behind Joe Biden.

on_screen_text.text: President Biden's Support for the Trans Community

spoken_summary: Addressing younger transgender Americans, Joe Biden says he will always have their back as president so they can be themselves and reach their potential. His remarks are followed by applause.
audio_music: The audio consists of a clear speech with the diegetic sound of an audience applauding at the end. There is no background music.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static shot without any edits or cuts.
central_claim: President Biden is a steadfast supporter of the transgender community.
intended_effect: To reassure transgender individuals and their allies of the President's support and to portray him and his party as inclusive.
